note: One canonical concept per engineering meaning. `aliases` are the words drawings write (matched as whole phrases after normalisation: upper case, dots dropped or spaced, status prefixes PRO/PROP/PROPOSED/EXG/EXISTING/NEW removed). `spec_key` links the design spec's vocabulary (agent-design-spec.ts SPEC_KEYS), `component_kind` the component table (agent-design-kinds.ts). `distinct_from` names concepts that must never be merged with this one without project evidence. `ambiguous` lists phrases that name more than one concept: the evidence (the level chain) decides, never the first match.

concepts.label: Rail level
concepts.definition: Level of the top of the rail.

concepts.label: Formation level
concepts.definition: Top of the railway embankment on which the ballast rests; free board is measured to it (IRBM 313).

concepts.label: Top of the structure (top slab / deck / pipe outside crown)
concepts.definition: Top face of the top slab of a box, of a deck, or the outside crown of a pipe.

concepts.label: Soffit level
concepts.definition: Underside of the top slab / deck (the inside crown of a pipe). Vertical clearance is measured to it (IRBM 312).

concepts.label: Bearing / seat level
concepts.definition: Top of the abutment, pier or bed block on which the superstructure bears.

concepts.label: Floor (top of bottom slab) / pipe invert
concepts.definition: Top face of a box's bottom slab (under any wearing course), or a pipe's inside invert.

concepts.label: Underside of the bottom slab
concepts.definition: Underside of a box's bottom slab (a pipe's outside invert).

concepts.label: High flood level (HFL)
concepts.definition: Highest water level known to have occurred at the site — a survey fact.

concepts.label: Water level of the design discharge (Q), including afflux
concepts.definition: The level vertical clearance (IRBM 312) and free board (IRBM 313) are measured from. Not the same as the HFL unless the project says so (KC-6).

concepts.label: Low water level (LWL)
concepts.definition: Ordinary low / dry-weather water level.

concepts.label: Bottom of foundation (B.O.F.)
concepts.definition: Underside of the foundation / footing — the founding level.

concepts.label: Top of footing
concepts.definition: Top face of a wing, abutment or pier footing.

concepts.label: Top of the wing / return wall (its coping)
concepts.definition: The level top of a wing or return wall — the top of its coping where it has one.

concepts.label: Bed level
concepts.definition: Level of the stream bed at the bridge; in a box on the railway convention, the top of the wearing course in the cells.

concepts.label: Ground level (natural / existing)
concepts.definition: Natural or existing ground level at the site, before fill or excavation.

concepts.label: Finished ground level (FGL)
concepts.definition: Ground level after the works (fill, paving). Not the natural ground level.

concepts.label: Lowest anticipated scoured bed level
concepts.definition: The bed level after the design scour; open foundations of other bridges go at least 1.75 m below it in ordinary soil (IRBM 403(2)).

concepts.label: Danger level
concepts.definition: Level at which the safety of the bridge is likely to be affected; fixed per bridge (IRBM 703).

concepts.label: Full supply level (canals)
concepts.definition: Full supply level of a canal; weep holes stay above it (IRBM 207(3)).

concepts.label: Clear span of a cell / span
concepts.definition: Inside-to-inside opening of a cell or span.

concepts.label: Clear height of a cell
concepts.definition: Inside height of a cell. Its lower datum (the structural floor or the top of the wearing course) is a project convention the written levels decide (KC-4).

concepts.label: Number of cells
concepts.definition: Count of the repeated openings of a box (topology input).

concepts.label: Number of spans
concepts.definition: Count of spans (topology input).

concepts.label: Deck slab thickness
concepts.definition: Depth of a slab deck.

concepts.label: Girder depth
concepts.definition: Depth of the superstructure girders.

concepts.label: Bearing + pedestal height
concepts.definition: Seat to soffit, through bearing and pedestal.

concepts.label: Abutment front batter (H per V)
concepts.definition: Horizontal per vertical of the abutment's front face.

concepts.label: Abutment back batter (H per V)
concepts.definition: Horizontal per vertical of the abutment's back face.

concepts.label: Abutment top width
concepts.definition: Width of the abutment at its top.

concepts.label: Pier batter (H per V, each face)
concepts.definition: Horizontal per vertical of each pier face.

concepts.label: Pier width (top)
concepts.definition: Width of a pier at its top.

concepts.label: Footing projection
concepts.definition: Projection of a footing beyond the wall or pier faces.

concepts.label: Number of pipes (rows)
concepts.definition: Count of pipe barrels (topology input).

concepts.label: Pipe internal diameter
concepts.definition: Inside diameter of a pipe barrel.

concepts.label: Pipe wall thickness
concepts.definition: Wall thickness of a pipe barrel.

concepts.label: Clear gap between pipes
concepts.definition: Clear distance between adjacent pipes.

concepts.label: Wall between cells
concepts.definition: Thickness of an internal (intermediate) wall of a box.

concepts.label: Outer wall
concepts.definition: Thickness of a box's outer (side) wall.

concepts.label: Top slab thickness
concepts.definition: Thickness of a box's top slab.

concepts.label: Bottom slab thickness
concepts.definition: Thickness of a box's bottom (base) slab.

concepts.label: Haunch
concepts.definition: Chamfer in the corners of a cell. No minimum is established by a source in hand (KC-3).

concepts.label: Bottom haunch
concepts.definition: Chamfer in the bottom corners of a cell, when it differs from the top.

concepts.label: Wearing course
concepts.definition: Concrete course on the bottom slab inside the cells.

concepts.label: Earth cushion
concepts.definition: Fill between the top of a buried structure and the formation (formation − top of structure). Its datum and minimum are not settled by a source in hand (KC-5).

concepts.label: Fill over the top slab at the box end (elevation)
concepts.definition: Height of the fill above the top slab where the elevation shows the structure's end.

concepts.label: Boulder backing width
concepts.definition: Thickness of the hand-packed boulder filling behind a wall; not less than 600 mm behind abutments and wing walls (IRBM 605(3)).

concepts.label: Wing top slope (H per V)
concepts.definition: Slope of the sloping top of a wing / return wall.

concepts.label: Fill / embankment slope (H per V)
concepts.definition: Side slope of the approach bank or fill.

concepts.label: Gap between the structure and the wing wall
concepts.definition: Joint between the structure and the wing wall (IRBM 604(2) butt joints).

concepts.label: Level stretch of the wing top at the structure
concepts.definition: Level portion of the wing top at the structure face.

concepts.label: Level portion at the far end of the wing
concepts.definition: Level portion of the wing top at its far end.

concepts.label: Wing wall length
concepts.definition: Length of a wing / return wall.

concepts.label: Wing coping depth
concepts.definition: Depth of the coping on a wing / return wall.

concepts.label: Coping chamfer
concepts.definition: Chamfer of the coping edge.

concepts.label: Coping overhang at the structure
concepts.definition: Overhang of the coping at the structure end.

concepts.label: Coping overhang at the far end
concepts.definition: Overhang of the coping at the far end.

concepts.label: Course under the wing footing
concepts.definition: Levelling / PCC course under a wing footing.

concepts.label: Projection of that course
concepts.definition: Projection of the course under a footing beyond the wall end.

concepts.label: Bed to the top of the footing
concepts.definition: Depth from the bed (or ground) down to the top of a footing.

concepts.label: Footing thickness
concepts.definition: The footing's own thickness (top of footing to B.O.F.). 'Footing depth' alone may also mean the embedment — the levels decide.

concepts.label: Vertical clearance (soffit − design water level)
concepts.definition: Soffit minus the water level of the design discharge incl. afflux (IRBM 312). Written as CL- or V.C. on drawings.

concepts.label: Free board (formation − design water level)
concepts.definition: Formation level minus the water level of the design discharge incl. afflux; not less than 1 m (IRBM 313(1)). Drawings often write F.B. against the HFL.

concepts.label: Depth of flow (HFL − bed)
concepts.definition: Water depth above the bed at the flood level a drawing writes (HFL − bed level). A check between levels, never a position.

concepts.label: Formation width
concepts.definition: Top width of the formation. No standard value is established in hand (KC-13).

concepts.label: Barrel length
concepts.definition: Length of a box or pipe barrel through the embankment (decided from the fill and cross-section; the documented formula is disputed, KC-2).

concepts.label: Skew angle
concepts.definition: Angle between the structure axis and the normal to the track; advisably ≤ 30° (IRBM 301(3)).

concepts.label: Design discharge Q
concepts.definition: Design discharge for waterway, normally the 50-year flood (IRBM 309).

concepts.label: Catchment area
concepts.definition: Catchment area; sets the Qf increase band (IRBM 310).

concepts.label: Left end of the level lines (drafting)
concepts.definition: Where the level lines end on the left — a drafting position, never a size.

concepts.label: Right end of the level lines (drafting)
concepts.definition: Where the right-hand level lines end — a drafting position.

concepts.label: Left end of the ground line (drafting)
concepts.definition: Drafting position.

concepts.label: Right end of the ground line (drafting)
concepts.definition: Drafting position.

concepts.label: RCC box (barrel)
concepts.definition: Closed RCC frame of one or more cells: top slab, bottom slab, outer and inner walls, haunches.

concepts.label: Pipe barrel
concepts.definition: Circular RCC / hume pipe barrel.

concepts.label: Deck / superstructure
concepts.definition: Slab or deck carrying the track over a span.

concepts.label: Slab element
concepts.definition: A slab element (cut-off, approach slab, slab unit).

concepts.label: Girder
concepts.definition: Primary girder / beam of a girder superstructure.

concepts.label: Abutment
concepts.definition: End support retaining the approach fill (IRBM 604).

concepts.label: Pier
concepts.definition: Intermediate support (IRBM 604).

concepts.label: Pier cap / bed block
concepts.definition: Cap or bed block on a pier or abutment on which bearings sit.

concepts.label: Bearing
concepts.definition: Interface transferring superstructure reactions; selection needs a controlled source (unknown).

concepts.label: Footing / open foundation
concepts.definition: Widened open foundation (IRBM 403).

concepts.label: Well foundation
concepts.definition: Circular or double-D well (IRBM 417–432).

concepts.label: Pile
concepts.definition: Pile of a pile foundation (IRBM 405–416).

concepts.label: Pile cap
concepts.definition: Cap joining a pile group.

concepts.label: Arch barrel
concepts.definition: Arch ring / barrel (intrados, extrados, spandrel).

concepts.label: Wing wall
concepts.definition: Wall retaining the approach-bank slope beside an abutment or box; splayed, straight, square or box type (IRBM 604(2)).

concepts.label: Return wall
concepts.definition: Wall parallel to the track retaining the bank (IRBM 604(2), 818).

concepts.label: Drop wall
concepts.definition: Downstream wall of a floor; depth 1.25 × D_Lacey for minor bridges (IRBM 818).

concepts.label: Curtain wall
concepts.definition: Upstream cut-off wall of a floor (IRBM 818, Annexure 2/2).

concepts.label: Toe wall
concepts.definition: Wall at the toe of pitching (Annexure 2/3).

concepts.label: Flooring / apron / pitching
concepts.definition: Floor covering the full width and length of abutments incl. wing walls, with its curtain and drop walls (IRBM 818).

concepts.label: Boulder backing
concepts.definition: Hand-packed boulders ≥ 600 mm behind abutments and wing walls, full height (IRBM 605(3)).

concepts.label: Courses under the structure
concepts.definition: PCC, sand, GSB, levelling and wearing courses.

concepts.label: Slope / embankment
concepts.definition: Sloping face of fill or cutting.

concepts.label: Earth fill / backfill
concepts.definition: Fill, backfill and the earth cushion; backfill of GW / GP / SW granular material (IRBM 605(3)).

concepts.label: Track
concepts.definition: Rails and sleepers on the ballast bed.

concepts.label: Ballast bed
concepts.definition: Ballast under the sleepers on the formation.

concepts.label: Road
concepts.definition: Road carriageway (RUB / ROB).

concepts.label: Weep hole
concepts.definition: Drainage hole at 1 m × 1 m staggered in abutments and wing walls; lowest row above LWL in flowing streams, 250 mm above bed otherwise, above FSL in canals (IRBM 207(3), 605(3)).

concepts.label: Reinforcement / dowels
concepts.definition: Bars, dowels, studs.

concepts.label: Joint
concepts.definition: Expansion / construction / butt joint (IRBM 604(2)).

concepts.label: Datum / axis
concepts.definition: Centre lines, level lines, axes.

concepts.label: Temporary works
concepts.definition: Shoring, sheet piles, falsework, cofferdams (IRBM 403(4), 404).

concepts.label: Battered wall
concepts.definition: A wall with a leaning face and coping (a part).

concepts.label: Proposed work
concepts.definition: New work shown in the proposed state.

concepts.label: Existing work
concepts.definition: Work that exists and stays.

concepts.label: To be dismantled
concepts.definition: Existing work removed by the proposal.

concepts.label: Extension of an existing structure
concepts.definition: A proposal that extends an existing bridge (doubling, extension); existing and proposed work and their junction are shown together.

ambiguous.note: On a deck it is the soffit; on a box it may be the underside of either slab. Tied by the level chain, never by the first match.
The footing's thickness or its depth below the bed — the levels decide (dimension ownership).
RL is a reduced level of anything — never the rail level by its letters. A bare RL is tied to the level it equals on the chain, or stays unassigned and is reported.
